patch_description:
Improve local search by treating the sorted vector of GPU KVPR values as a lexicographic objective rather than considering only the single maximum KVPR. This permits neutral moves that keep the current maximum unchanged while reducing another tied bottleneck, often enabling a later move that lowers the true maximum.

The search is also focused on GPUs currently attaining the bottleneck KVPR. This preserves objective relevance and reduces unnecessary exploration of moves between non-critical GPUs, offsetting the extra candidate comparison work.
